messages:
Ari (PM): quick sync: we need to finalize the beta plan for the Meridian Health design partner. main goals: recruitment targets, scope guardrails, and a clear feedback loop. who can hop on 15m?
Sam (Eng): I can. quick question: do we want a timeboxed cohort or a rolling intake?
Rina (Solutions): timeboxed cohorts (2 weeks each) help us compare before/after fixes. recommend small initial cohort then scaled follow-up. :white_check_mark:
Tess (Research): agree. we'll need a canonical eval harness and per-partner sample flows (5-8 flows).
Ari (PM): proposed structure:
- Cohort 1: 6 private seats (on-prem/VPC) 
- Cohort 2: 15 hosted seats (early access)
- Cohort 3: open waitlist + monitoring
Acceptance gates: no regressions on canonical eval, critical-field hallucination <= 2.5%, partner-reported blocker rate < 1/week.
Sam (Eng): technical constraints: private installs need a preflight checklist (network, KMS keys, ops connectivity). that adds ~3 days setup per partner.
infra-bot: Note: default telemetry retention 90d. To extend retention or ingest custom telemetry, open ticket infra/telemetry-retention.
Rina (Solutions): recruitment note: Meridian requires HIPAA controls. Cohort 1 must be private with partner-managed KMS. we'll include that in pitch.
Tess (Research): feedback channels: in-app quick thumbs (ok/problem), structured issue form with file upload, and biweekly 30m synthesis call. plus a Slack webhook for urgent items.
Ari (PM): draft acceptance criteria for legal/security:
```
- Deployment: Cohort 1 private with partner KMS and VPC peering
- Security: audit logs enabled, no plaintext PHI stored; redaction enabled by default
- Reliability objective: 99% availability during business hours for Cohort 1 (soft)
- Quality: pass rate >= 93% on canonical eval set
- Feedback cadence: partner provides >=3 annotated examples/week during active window
```
Sam (Eng): SLA phrasing: call it "availability objective" for Cohort 1 (we can't guarantee full SLA until infra baseline validated). formal SLA starts with Cohort 2.
Rina (Solutions): escalation/rollback plan: if >4 critical incidents in 7 days, auto-revert to last stable model, notify partner and spin incident bridge. add this to the partner playbook.
Tess (Research): telemetry payload fields to capture for evaluation: input_id, anonymized_user_id, route, model_hash, label, notes. example payload: {"input_id": "abcd-1234", "model_variant": "v2-8bit", "label": "ok/issue"}
Sam (Eng): we'll surface latency p50/p95 and token-cost per request in weekly dashboard. also add a health-check endpoint for private installs.
Ari (PM): recruitment incentives: 3 months 50% off Dedicated for Cohort 1, plus priority for feature requests during pilot. ok?
Rina (Solutions): sounds fair. helps offset private setup ops.
Tess (Research): measurement plan: baseline metrics to collect pre-onboard: tokens/day, avg response latency, annotated issues/week. will produce weekly delta reports.
Sam (Eng): ops ask: can Eng commit to a 72h hotfix window for critical bugs during Cohort 1? need to confirm on-call coverage.
infra-bot: On-call update: eng-night oncall available Tue-Thu nights for next 8 weeks. For extended coverage, contact oncall-manager.
Ari (PM): action items:
- Sam: private-deploy preflight checklist + health-check endpoint PR (due Tue EOD)
- Tess: canonical eval harness + 8 partner flows (due Wed)
- Rina: partner pitch doc with rollback/escalation + incentive text (due Wed)
- Ari: legal/security blurb (KMS, retention, redaction) and partner one-pager (due Fri)
- Ops: confirm telemetry retention exception or plan (blocker)
Rina (Solutions): I'll reach out to Meridian infra contact to validate VPC peering constraints and get a list of contacts.
Tess (Research): once eval set is locked, I'll wire up an automated delta report and add a simple scoring script for non-research folks.
Sam (Eng): I'll add a lightweight diagnostics page for partners (latency, env checks) and tag @Ari when ready.
Ari (PM): thanks team. I'll assemble a short partner-facing README with the acceptance gates and cadence and share for review. ping here if anything missing. :rocket:
